company.description:
TrueClaim is an online solution that enables patients to see their healthcare providers and also offer feedback regarding their medical consultations. The solution processes medical bills and uses patients’ answers to check for errors in them.

TrueClaim is operated from Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
